title: NJ Transit Slashes World Cup Train Fares to $98 as Tickets Go on Sale — NYC Unveils 'Soccer Streets' Car-Free Zones
detail: On May 13, NJ Transit officially reduced its round-trip rail fare for the eight World Cup matches at MetLife Stadium from $150 (later temporarily lowered to $105) to $98, with ticket purchases opening May 13 via the NJ Transit Mobile App. Shuttle bus fares were simultaneously cut from $80 to $20 per person round-trip. Customers who had already purchased shuttle tickets at the prior $80 rate received automatic $60 refunds. The original $150 fare had drawn intense public backlash, given that the normal round-trip fare for the same Secaucus Junction route is $12.90. New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced the reduced shuttle rate and called the new pricing a step toward fan accessibility. Separately, New York City unveiled 'Soccer Streets' — a plan to close streets near approximately 50 city schools to vehicle traffic during the tournament as a public celebration initiative. MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ will host eight matches including the July 19 World Cup Final. The venue lacks direct transit connections and relies heavily on shuttle buses and NJ Transit rail links, making transportation logistics one of the most complex aspects of the 2026 tournament.

media.caption: NJ Transit cuts World Cup round-trip fares to $98 as ticket sales open May 13 — shuttle buses slashed to $20 for MetLife Stadium, host of the July 19 Final

title: England's Ben White Ruled Out of World Cup With MCL Injury — Arsenal Defender Ends International Return Under Tuchel
detail: Arsenal and England defender Ben White was ruled out of the 2026 FIFA World Cup after sustaining medial collateral ligament (MCL) damage in the 28th minute of Arsenal's 1-0 Premier League victory over West Ham. The injury confirmed his season and tournament are over with no recovery timeline issued. The ruling is particularly significant because White had returned to England contention under Thomas Tuchel following a nearly four-year international absence — he had not represented England since controversially withdrawing from the 2022 World Cup squad mid-tournament in Qatar. Tuchel had reintegrated White into his defensive plans, and his exclusion forces a rethink ahead of the England squad announcement on May 22. White's MCL damage follows Patrick Agyemang's (USA) Achilles rupture and other pre-tournament injuries that have reshaped multiple squads. England are drawn in a group-stage path that puts them on course for knockout matches across US venues.

media.caption: Ben White ruled out of the 2026 World Cup with MCL injury — ends Arsenal defender's England return under Tuchel ahead of May 22 squad announcement

title: Mexico World Cup Roster Crisis: Federation Threatens to Exclude Liga MX Stars; Chucky Lozano Dropped From Provisional Squad
detail: A major internal dispute erupted in Mexican football as coach Javier Aguirre convened a 20-man domestic training camp during the Liga MX Clausura quarterfinals — outside the official FIFA international window — forcing clubs to choose between league playoff commitments and the national team. The Mexican Football Federation issued an ultimatum: any player who fails to report will be excluded from the final World Cup squad. Aguirre granted a special exemption only to Toluca players participating in the CONCACAF Champions Cup semifinals, drawing accusations of favoritism from other clubs. Chivas president Amaury Vergara publicly challenged the decision on social media, arguing that players who honor club commitments in a parallel competition should not face World Cup exclusion. A further flashpoint: Hirving 'Chucky' Lozano — formerly one of Mexico's most prominent internationals — was excluded from Mexico's 55-man provisional World Cup roster, signaling a definitive end to his international career under Aguirre. The episode reflects deep structural tensions between Liga MX's commercial calendar and the national federation's authority heading into Mexico's home World Cup. Mexico open the entire tournament on June 11 at Estadio Azteca against South Africa.

media.caption: Mexico squad row escalates: Federation threatens World Cup exclusion for Liga MX players who miss Aguirre's camp; Chucky Lozano dropped from provisional 55-man roster
